tasks.prompt: Review the Rust code under src/ for correctness bugs (logic errors, panics, unwrap on None, off-by-one, race conditions). Report each as file:line + one sentence. If none, say so.
Review the code under src/ for security issues (path traversal, command injection, unvalidated input, secret leakage). Report each as file:line + one sentence. If none, say so.
Run `cargo test` and report the pass/fail counts and any failing test names. Do not edit anything.

synthesis.prompt: Merge the review findings and test results into one prioritized list (highest severity first). Deduplicate, and note which task surfaced each item. End with a one-line go/no-go verdict.
